issue.title: Notification +1 corroboration and ci_watch incident-combination dedup
issue.description: A repeated CI failure adds a quiet, visible +1 note to its existing notification instead of a new notification; a new notification arrives only when a repo that no existing CI-failure notification covers starts failing.

issue.title: Rust notification store +1 model and upsert
issue.description: core: add plus-one entries and a dedup key to the Rust notification row, an append-plus-one operation, and an atomic create-or-plus-one/supersede upsert with parity tests.

issue.title: sase notify +1 and create upsert
issue.description: cli: mirror the new wire in Python, add the notify +1 subcommand and create dedup-key/plus-one/supersede flags, and render +1 evidence in notify list/show and JSON.

issue.title: Notification panel +1 badges and iteration
issue.description: panel: render +1 badges and an evidence section in the ACE notification modal, add a + key that cycles the detail pane through +1 notes, and extend the PNG snapshot suites.

issue.title: ci_watch incident-combination notifications
issue.description: chop: collapse per-repo ci_watch failure notifications into one incident-combination notification that +1s material deltas, supersedes itself when a new repo starts failing, and falls back to legacy behavior on older sase CLIs.

issue.title: Integrated verification and config alignment
issue.description: verify: run both repos' verification lanes plus the monitored check-full landing gate, smoke the upsert end to end, and align the chezmoi-managed chop description with the new subprocess surface.

payload.entry:
DISCOVERED ISSUE (found by the sase-y3 land agent during its just check-full landing gate): phase sase-y6.5's commit 9abf4724c 'feat(notifications): add +1 badge CLI and split notification store into facade/wire/catalog layers' added CLI surface without regenerating the checked-in completion snapshot, so master is red on two nodes.

FAILING NODES: tests/completion/test_snapshot.py::test_checked_in_snapshot_has_no_drift and ::test_current_structural_view_matches_checked_in_snapshot. Reproduced deterministically in isolation (.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/completion/test_snapshot.py -q), not only under the full parallel lane. Observed at HEAD 63f385c9a on 2026-09-08.

EVIDENCE: diffed current_structural_view() against tests/completion/snapshots/cli_spec.json; the entire delta (155 diff lines, nothing else) is confined to .root.subcommands[notify]: a new '+1' subcommand subtree (positionals id/note, options -k/--dedup-key, -s/--sender) plus three new 'notify create' options (-k/--dedup-key, -p/--plus-one-note, -S/--supersedes) and its changed description_digest. git log -S'Append a +1 corroboration note' -- src/sase/main/parser_commands.py names 9abf4724c as the sole introducing commit, and that commit's stat touches parser_commands.py but not cli_spec.json.

NOT CAUSED BY sase-y3: the sase-y3 land tree's diff (src/sase/sdd/_artifact_link_machine_store.py, sdd/artifact_link_store.py, workspace_provider/_ownership_authorize.py, workspace_provider/_ownership_types.py, agents_sync/referenced_by_publication.py, scripts/sase_chop_artifact_link_backfill.py) contains no argparse or completion-snapshot change.

FIX: just sync-completion-spec (tools/sync_completion_spec --write), committed with the sase-y6 landing. Worth also checking any test that hardcodes the notify subcommand list, as the analogous artifact-link drift instance recorded on sase-pr broke a second alphabetical-options test alongside the snapshot nodes; the check-full run reported only these two failures.

CLASS CONTEXT: same recurring mechanism documented on task sase-pr (closed superseded 2026-09-06, evidence attribution transferred to sase-o0) - a commit adds argparse surface without regenerating cli_spec.json. Routed here as the causing epic rather than as a new task or a +1 on that superseded bead.
